verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a 'modern and flexible 3D renderer' with extensible custom shaders/materials/pipelines, and community hands-on feedback confirms shadows exist (though called 'jagged/low-res, reminds me of early Unity shadows'). However, the evidence pack never mentions global illumination, baked lighting, or a post-processing stack explicitly. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of GI/baked lighting support, explicit post-processing feature list, and independent corroboration of PBR material quality beyond the shadow-quality caveat.
